"[blue]Hello there trainer. [green]Berry Forest[blue] is an interesting challenge for trainers that are looking for some practice. It's a small maze of sorts with potent foes. There may be a prize at the end. Or maybe not. Are you interested?"

[green]Berry Forest[blue] was its true home, where it'd stop occasionally to bless trainers with its presence\. However, its recent attack on the poor [green]Lostelle[blue] was truly out of character! But, now it makes sense\. [green]Mew[blue] has been angsty knowing [green]Mewtwo[blue] has awoken in the cave it resided in\."

"[green]Mewtwo: [blue]I admit, I was once an apathetic machine\. But ever since I've been under the wing of [green][player][blue], I've become far less belligerent\. I've come simply so I could witness the power of my original."
"[blue]Mm\. I've heard tales of your potential to communicate. It seems they are true. Fine, if it's a battle you seek, I will do my best to deliver. It may help [green]Mew[blue] loosen up."

"[blue]Yes\. From this fight, I can attest that [green]Mewtwo[blue] is under good hands."

"[blue]Hmm, how peculiar. It seems [green]Mew's [blue]stats are significantly inferior to mine. However, it has the capability of learning nearly every single technique. "[blue]Your Start menu and other functions have been disabled. So, you won't be able to heal. There are various trainers here that will open up paths if you defeat them. I'll be here if you want me to escort you out. Best of luck."

"Okay well, I can heal two Pokémon. Shall I heal the first?"
"Do you want me to heal another?"
